_comment: Control. A service handed to a host builtin (`process.zzHost`, a member of `process`) and exported from the entry, in that source order; the program calls one method and the test calls the other through the export. Green before and after the escape marks repair: every method stays. Why it is green before the repair is a reading of the code, not a probe: the call waits for the member load on `process`, so the export's escape to code the pass can't see is likely the first to run.
